name: @wippy-swiss/echarts
title: ECharts
description: Lazy ECharts 6.1 web component. options is always the complete desired option, never a patch. Theme and renderer changes reset interaction state. Tag: <wippy-echarts>.

wippy.description:
Provides the <wippy-echarts> custom element. Drop into any app via
`ns.dependency`, wire the `server` requirement to your gateway, and
consumers call loadByTagName('wippy-echarts') to register the tag lazily.

Renders ECharts 6.1 charts from a JSON option; the engine loads on first render.
Text, axes, borders and categorical colors follow the host CSS.
Part of the wippy-swiss collection.

  - name: server
    kind: ns.requirement
    meta:
      description: The http.service entry that hosts this module's static bundle, typically your app's gateway.
    targets:
      - entry: wippy-swiss.echarts:static
path: .meta.server

  - name: public_files
    kind: fs.directory
    meta:
      comment: Built echarts web component bundle
    directory: ./public/
    mode: "0755"

  - name: static
    kind: http.static
    meta:
      comment: Serves echarts web component bundle
      server: server
    fs: public_files
    directory: /
    path: /@static-wippy-swiss/echarts
    options:
      mime_types:
.js: application/javascript
.css: text/css
.map: application/json

  - name: wippy-echarts
    kind: registry.entry
    meta:
      type: view.component
      name: wippy-echarts
      title: ECharts
      tag_name: wippy-echarts
      entry_point: index.js
      announced: true
      secure: false
      auto_register: false
      url: /@static-wippy-swiss/echarts
      description: |
Renders ECharts 6.1 line, bar, pie, scatter, heatmap, funnel, gauge and radar
charts from the complete JSON option in options. Includes grid, tooltip, legend,
dataset, aria, title, dataZoom, marks, visualMap, calendar and radar coordinates.
Canvas and SVG are supported. Maps, graph, sankey and toolbox are excluded.

Await loadByTagName('wippy-echarts') from @wippy-fe/proxy before use.
The registry announces the tag with auto_register=false. A cached dynamic
engine chunk loads for the first valid, sized render. lazy-init also waits
until within 200px of the viewport. The chart fills the height its container
gives it; without a container height, it keeps a 2:1 shape. Set height or
aspect-ratio on the element to change it. Loading and errors overlay the
chart box. loading-text supplies the wippy-loading title.

options is always a full option, including with not-merge=false. Replacement
is the default. Native merge retains interaction state unless options override
it. Theme, palette and renderer changes recreate from the current full option
and reset interaction state. Only the latest option is used during loading.
JSON functions never execute; use declarative $format descriptors instead.
Tooltips use richText. Links allow HTTP, HTTPS, mailto and relative URLs.

Text, borders and surfaces use host tokens; fonts use the host's computed font.
Palette precedence is palette JSON, --wippy-chart-1 through --wippy-chart-8,
then the documented categorical fallback. Auto follows host.getThemeMode(),
@theme and @config. System preference changes apply only in Auto.

label names the figure, followed by the first non-empty option title, then Chart.
autoresize, loading, not-merge, lazy-update and group control rendering.
chart-click, chart-dblclick and chart-hover emit
{label,datasetLabel,datasetIndex,dataIndex,value}. legend-change emits {selected},
datazoom emits {start,end}, and chart-error emits {message} with an alert.
chart-rendered emits {} once the next finished event completes a requested
option update or recreation, after animations, progressive rendering and lazy
updates. Hover and resize redraws alone do not emit it. All events bubble and
are composed. Aria descriptions default on; consumers supply keyboard actions.

Example:

<wippy-echarts
  label="Share"
  options='{"series":[{"type":"pie","data":[{"name":"A","value":1}]}]}'></wippy-echarts>

options.description: Complete desired ECharts option as JSON, including with not-merge=false. Empty means {}. Formatter callbacks accept {$format: spec}: number, number:0..20, compact, percent, integer, date, datetime, month or time:<template>. Colours accept $seriesColor with alpha, $seriesGradient with from/to/direction, or $themeColor with text/muted/border/surface and optional alpha. Example: {"series":[{"type":"line","data":[1,2],"areaStyle":{"color":{"$seriesGradient":{"from":0.35,"to":0}}}}]}. Alpha must be 0 to 1. Colours resolve again on theme or palette changes. Invalid markers warn and use defaults. JSON never executes.

theme-mode.description: Auto follows the host theme mode; light/dark override ECharts contrast mode locally. Resolved host tokens remain authoritative.

palette.description: JSON array of color strings. Overrides --wippy-chart-1..8 and the documented fallback palette. Empty uses CSS colors.

renderer.description: ECharts rendering backend. Changing it disposes and recreates from the current full option, resetting zoom, legend selection and other interaction state.

autoresize.description: Resize with the container using ResizeObserver.

loading.description: Show the platform wippy-loading overlay inside the reserved chart box.

loading-text.description: Title of the platform loading overlay, including during the first engine load.

not-merge.description: Controls how a new full option is applied to the live chart. True replaces (default); false uses native ECharts merge for data animation and retained zoom/legend state unless explicitly overridden. Never enables patch input.

lazy-update.description: Defer the ECharts option update until the next animation frame.

group.description: ECharts connect group id. Empty disables group membership.

label.description: Accessible figure name. Empty uses the first non-empty option title text, then Chart.

lazy-init.description: Wait until within 200px of the viewport before loading ECharts and initializing. Falls back to immediate initialization without IntersectionObserver.

chart-click.description: Data element event; empty space emits nothing. Bubbles and is composed.

label.description: Category or x value as text.

value.description: Raw data point or dataset row, matching wippy-chartjs.

chart-dblclick.description: Data element event; empty space emits nothing. Bubbles and is composed.

label.description: Category or x value as text.

value.description: Raw data point or dataset row, matching wippy-chartjs.

chart-hover.description: Data element event; empty space emits nothing. Bubbles and is composed.

label.description: Category or x value as text.

value.description: Raw data point or dataset row, matching wippy-chartjs.

legend-change.description: Legend selection changed. Bubbles and is composed.

datazoom.description: First affected dataZoom range, in percent; null if a value-based action omitted percentages. Bubbles and is composed.

chart-rendered.description: Empty detail once a requested option update or recreation finishes animations, progressive rendering and lazy updates. Hover and resize redraws alone do not emit it. Bubbles and is composed.

chart-error.description: Parse, import or initialization error. Bubbles and is composed.
